falseSynonyms.zh: 不喜歡不等於 lose interest in dislike 表示負面喜惡；lose interest in 可以只是興趣淡化，未必討厭。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Loss of interest does not necessarily mean dislike.

falseSynonyms.zh: 憎恨遠強於 lose interest in hate 是強烈負面情緒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hate is much stronger than losing interest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忽略不等於失去興趣 ignore 是不理會某事的行為；原因未必是興趣下降。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Ignoring is behaviour, not necessarily a change in interest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 忘記不等於 lose interest in forget 是記憶問題；lose interest in 是態度／注意力改變。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Forgetting and losing interest are different processes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 放棄不等於一定失去興趣 give up 表示停止做某事；可能因時間、金錢或困難，而不是興趣下降。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Stopping an activity does not prove loss of interest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 只在 boredom sense 接近 如果興趣因人生重點改變而淡化，不一定是 boredom。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Boredom is only one cause of lost interest.

falseSynonyms.zh: 英式口語近義詞，但可帶『不再喜歡』 go off 比 lose interest in 更口語，也有其他義項。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Go off is informal and polysemous.

falseSynonyms.zh: 詞性陷阱 interest 可作名詞／動詞；interested 是形容詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interest and interested have different grammatical roles.
